indicator: Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (CPI-U)

next_release.source: Stated in the September 2026 release: scheduled to be published on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. (ET)

comparison_basis: FREE SAMPLE, trimmed: first 2 of 5 items in the latest release. The paid card has all 5 items, each a summary plus the verbatim quote. Monthly changes seasonally adjusted, September 2026 vs August 2026; 12-month changes not seasonally adjusted. No calculated figures.

items.summary: CPI-U +0.6% in September (seasonally adjusted) after +0.4% in August; +3.7% over the 12 months ending September, up from 3.4% through August.
items.quote: increased 0.6 percent on a seasonally adjusted basis in September after rising 0.4 percent in August; The all items index rose 3.7 percent for the 12 months ending September, a larger increase than the 3.4-percent increase reported for the 12 months ending in August

items.summary: Core CPI (all items less food and energy) +0.3% in September, as in August; +2.6% over the year, after 2.4% over the 12 months ending August.
items.quote: The index for all items less food and energy rose 0.3 percent in September, as it did in August; The all items less food and energy index rose 2.6 percent over the year, following a 2.4-percent increase over the 12 months ending August
